ferromark-native.notes: Full spec profiles; GFM adds autolink literals and tagfilter to the timed shared profile.

ferromark-node.notes: The public Node HTML API retains fence metadata handling; other optional syntax uses addon defaults. GFM adds autolinks and tagfilter.

pulldown-cmark.notes: No public literal-autolink or tagfilter switch in 0.13.4. ENABLE_GFM only enables blockquote alerts and is intentionally off.

md4c.notes: Adds all permissive autolinks. No public tagfilter option; the broader GITHUB preset also enables footnotes and admonitions.

bun.gfm: Only tables, strikethrough, tasklists, permissive_autolinks, tag_filter true
bun.notes: Direct native Bun MD implementation, not the JavaScript Bun.markdown boundary. Adds autolinks and tagfilter.

ox-content.notes: Renderer retains built-in IDs, TOC, callouts, and fence handling: the public renderer has no disable switches. Adds parser autolinks and tagfilter.

markdown-rs.notes: Full formal GFM features including tagfilter; enables literal autolinks beyond timed profile.

comrak.notes: Uses the released 0.55.0 tagfilter option despite its upstream deprecation. Adds literal autolinks and tagfilter.

cmark-gfm.gfm: Same; attach table, strikethrough, tasklist, autolink, tagfilter
cmark-gfm.notes: Enables full formal extensions. CommonMark implementation targets an older spec; measured against 0.31.2.

goldmark.notes: No tagfilter option in pinned public v2 API. Adds linkify to the timed profile.

marked.notes: Uses stock GFM URL tokenizer, unlike timing. Raw HTML passes through; no tagfilter option.

markdown-it.commonmark: commonmark preset; html=true, linkify=false, typographer=false, validateLink accepts all protocols
markdown-it.gfm: Same; linkify=true, enable table/strikethrough/linkify, markdown-it-task-lists defaults
markdown-it.notes: Task plugin adds CSS classes. Linkify is the public URL recognizer; no tagfilter option. Adds linkify to timing profile.

remark.gfm: Same; micromark table/strike/tasks/autolink extensions and corresponding mdast extensions
remark.notes: Raw HAST passes through; no tagfilter option in this pipeline. Adds literal autolink extension to timing profile.

micromark.gfm: Same; table/strike/tasks/autolink syntax and HTML extensions plus tagfilter HTML extension
micromark.notes: Enables the five formal GFM extensions without footnotes. Adds autolinks and tagfilter to timing profile.

showdown.notes: Closest public rendering options; no CommonMark preset or GFM tagfilter. Literal underscores enabled beyond timing profile.

commonmark.notes: CommonMark-only public API; same options as timing.

remarkable.notes: Supports partial extensions but no task-list API/plugin in this pinned workspace; full GFM suite unsupported.

satteri.notes: rawHtml=false preserves opaque raw nodes verbatim; true reparses HTML. Uses the public native addon, not a substituted Rust crate. Same as timing profile.

md4x-napi.notes: Public native addon cannot disable its parser extensions or select a formal spec profile. Both suites measured, not relabeled as CommonMark-only.

ox-content-napi.notes: Native binding retains renderer builtins and lacks renderer tagfilter options. Adds parser autolinks to timing profile.

tanstack-markdown.notes: Cannot disable built-in tables/strike/tasks/footnotes. Both suites measured. Same options as timing profile.
